early_warning.task: Early-warning: new FDA shortage posting for a medicine within the next 6 months

clustering.note: k is chosen by silhouette among k>=3 (k=2 usually just splits 'one-off' from 'repeat' medicines).

status_classification.task: Status classification (is the shortage record still active?)

temporal.note: The newest postings are overwhelmingly still active, so the share of positives changes sharply over time (see positive_rate). Scores here measure robustness to that drift, not everyday accuracy.

duration.skipped: Only 19 resolved records with valid dates.
